items.title: Return completed accident questionnaire (Fragebogen zum Unfallhergang)
items.quote: Bitte senden Sie uns den ausgefüllten Fragebogen innerhalb von 10 Arbeitstagen (Montag bis Freitag, ohne Feiertage) nach dem Briefdatum zurück.
items.computation: The letter's own date is Wed 06.05.2026; it sets the period as running 'nach dem Briefdatum' (from the letter's date), not from delivery, so the letter's date itself is the anchor. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (06.05.2026) is not counted; counting starts 07.05.2026. The letter defines 'Arbeitstage' itself as Monday-Friday excluding public holidays, matching § 193 BGB logic. Counting 10 such business days from 07.05.2026, skipping Sat 09.05, Sun 10.05, the nationwide holiday Christi Himmelfahrt on Thu 14.05.2026, and the following weekend (16.-17.05): day 1=07.05 (Thu), 2=08.05 (Fri), 3=11.05 (Mon), 4=12.05 (Tue), 5=13.05 (Wed), 14.05 skipped (holiday), 6=15.05 (Fri), 7=18.05 (Mon), 8=19.05 (Tue), 9=20.05 (Wed), 10=21.05 (Thu). This holiday falls on the same date whether Bayern (sender's registered seat, Musterhausen 80331) or Nordrhein-Westfalen (recipient's Land) calendar is used, so the result is unaffected by which Land's holidays apply. The 10th business day is Thursday 21.05.2026, which is not a Saturday, Sunday or holiday, so no further shift applies.
